description: Use this when someone wants to estimate a property tax bill ("how much is my property tax"), see what a home improvement would add ("does a deck raise property taxes, and by how much"), or see what a successful appeal would save per year. Works for any US address, county or state. Give the assessed value from the tax bill or notice, or a street address and the assessed value is looked up. For the tax rate give any one of: the current annual tax bill, a rate in percent, a millage rate, or just the state and county (or an address) and the typical local effective rate is used and labeled as an estimate. Scenarios: estimate_bill, improvement (add improvementCost or addedAssessedValue), appeal (add newAssessedValue or reductionPercent). The formula and rate source are shown. Read-only.

addedAssessedValue.description: Added assessed value from the improvement, if known.

address.description: Full US street address. Used to look up the assessed value and the local rate when they are not given.

annualTaxBill.description: Current annual property tax bill in dollars; used to derive the effective rate.

assessedValue.description: Assessed value in dollars as shown on the tax bill or notice (not necessarily market value). Optional when an address is given.

county.description: County name. Used with the state for the typical local rate.

improvementCost.description: Cost of the home improvement in dollars (treated as a ceiling on added assessed value).

millRate.description: Millage rate in mills per $1,000, for example 18.

newAssessedValue.description: Target assessed value after a successful appeal.

reductionPercent.description: Percent reduction in assessed value after a successful appeal.

scenario.description: Which calculation to run. Defaults to the one implied by the other fields.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code. Used for the typical local rate when no rate is given.

taxRatePercent.description: Tax rate in percent, for example 1.8.

name: calculate_property_tax
title: Property tax bill and what-if calculator
